apiTestSkeleton.name: should map API response to model on success and set error on server error
steps: Arrange: create mock success response and mock error response
Assert: on success mappedModel equals expectedModel; on error component.errorState === true
apiTestSkeleton.pseudocode: mockApi.call.mockResolvedValue(mockSuccess); await sut(); expect(sut.model).toEqual(expectedModel); mockApi.call.mockRejectedValue({status:500}); await sut(); expect(sut.error).toBe(true);

componentTestSkeleton.name: should render with correct props and handle click
steps: Assert event handler called and state changed

coverageGapTestSkeleton.name: should cover uncovered branch when specific condition met

Set up minimal state to trigger that branch
Execute the method containing the branch
